thread:
mira: pushed a draft PR for the ratecard/usage section — includes a sample that shows per-tier metering + burst credits. need quick sanity check on the SDK snippets and the grafana panel json link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4512

alex: thanks — skimmed. two quick notes: 1) telemetry metric name changed last month from `rate.total` to `rate_requests_total` (plural + underscore). 2) the sample dashboard uses `tier` label but our ingestion uses `plan` label now. we should align the snippet.

sam: correct on both. current metric is `rate_requests_total{plan="pro|free"}` and burst is emitted as `rate_burst_credits_used`. panel json I linked below is the compact version we use in infra dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/ratecard-compact.json

mira: thanks. should we add migration notes saying old metric aliases (rate.total) will still be accepted for 6 months?

jordan: yes add a short note in the docs/upgrade section — ops asked for a 6-month alias window. keeps existing customers safe.

alex: also, the pricing example in the draft uses a naive `tokens * price_per_token`. for tiered metering we should show the canonical calc: `base_units = floor(tokens / 1000); cost = base_units * tier_rate + max(0, burst_used) * burst_rate`. small pseudo snippet helps users avoid undercharging mistakes.

mira: added that pseudo-snippet in the PR, plus an annotated table for `pro|startup|free` rates. can folks glance at the math and confirm?

sam: looks right. one thing — the dashboard panel uses a transform that sums `rate_requests_total` across `region` which inflates numbers in the docs example. change transform to sum by `plan` only. patch incoming to the panel JSON.

alex: for the SDK snippets, do we want Node + Python only? or add Go?

mira: Node + Python first. we can add Go in a follow-up. the Node snippet uses SDKv7 helpers — check the auth header example.

alex: minor nit: SDK examples should show `client.listUsage({ start, end, group_by: ['plan'] })` (not `groupBy`) to match naming in the SDK. I'll push a tiny change to the snippet in the PR.

docs-ci-bot: deploy preview available — https://deploy.preview.redwood/4512 (commit abc123). check the rendered upgrade note and the pricing table. :white_check_mark:

mira: reclaiming the TODOs: alex will update the snippet key names + math wording, sam will push the fixed panel JSON to the dashboards repo and post the final raw link, jordan will add the 6-month alias sentence in upgrade.md. I'll then merge once CI is green.

alex: done — pushed `docs: sdk naming fix + calc wording` (commit def456).

sam: dashboard JSON pushed to infra-dashboards repo at `dashboards/ratecard/metering-panel-2026.json`. final link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/ratecard/metering-panel-2026.json

jordan: added upgrade note in `docs/upgrade.md` and flagged the 6-month window in the PR description.

mira: merging after one more lint pass. leaving this thread open for any late regressions. thanks all!
notes: coordination thread for docs PR on rate limits/quotas pricing samples + dashboard JSON + SDK snippet naming. action owners: alex, sam, jordan, mira. included deploy preview and final dashboard link.
